title: Agentation: overview film
description: Show coding agents what to fix. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 50 seconds: Agentation for TYPO3 v14. Notes on backend screens; Connect your agent in one step. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Clients describe problems in words, like the button on the right, and your coding agent has to guess the element.
With Agentation, you click an element and write a note for your coding agent.
It works on backend screens too, so editors can mark up any module.
Copy the MCP configuration, check the status and manage the notes in one module.
Each note carries the selector, the page and the computed styles to Claude Code or Cursor. Visitors never see the toolbar.
